cl_alc_hangover_mood.q: Why do I feel anxious or low the day after drinking?
cl_alc_hangover_mood.short: On hangover days, people felt more worried, low and guilty than on days without drinking.
cl_alc_hangover_mood.but: Nobody measured how big the change is, and poor sleep or regret may cause part of it.
how: One review gathered 22 studies with over 6,000 people, mostly young adults.
People rated their mood on a hangover day and on a sober day.
Most studies found worse mood when hungover, but a couple found no change in worry, at least for some people.

cl_alc_hangover_mood_coping.q: Does anything help with the worry or low mood of a hangover?
cl_alc_hangover_mood_coping.short: No one has tested anything for hangover worry; people said talking with friends helped.
cl_alc_hangover_mood_coping.but: These are people's own stories, not tests, so we cannot say what really helps.
how: Researchers interviewed about a hundred young adults about their hangovers.
Many felt bad about things they did while drunk or could not remember.
No study compared people who tried something with people who did not.

cl_alc_sleep_rem.q: What does drinking before bed do to my dream sleep?
cl_alc_sleep_rem.short: After drinking, dream sleep started later and was shorter than on nights without alcohol.
cl_alc_sleep_rem.but: These were small sleep-lab studies, and the results were not the same in every study.
how: Researchers measured sleep in a sleep lab with sensors on people's heads.
The same people slept one night after alcohol and one night without it.
The more people drank, the more dream sleep they lost.

cl_alc_sleep_onset.q: Does a drink help me fall asleep or sleep longer?
cl_alc_sleep_onset.short: A drink before bed did not help people fall asleep faster than nights without alcohol.
cl_alc_sleep_onset.but: Whether it changes how long people sleep is unclear, because the studies disagreed.
how: 27 small sleep-lab studies were put together in one review.
On average, falling asleep took about the same time with or without alcohol.
Only after larger amounts was falling asleep a little quicker.
In some studies, people felt they fell asleep faster after a drink.

cl_alc_water_dehydration.q: Is a hangover just being thirsty, and does drinking water fix it?
cl_alc_water_dehydration.short: No one had tested water as a hangover cure; thirst faded by late morning, hangovers stayed.
cl_alc_water_dehydration.but: The numbers come from the researchers' own surveys and a walking study, not from a test.
how: On a long walk, people with worse hangovers drank more water.
But drinking more water did not make their hangover get better faster.
Students said water helped a bit, scoring it about 5 out of 10.

cl_caf_sleep_that_night.q: Does caffeine during the day affect my sleep that night?
cl_caf_sleep_that_night.short: After caffeine, people slept about 45 minutes less than on nights without caffeine.
cl_caf_sleep_that_night.but: Most people tested were young men who rarely had caffeine, so regular drinkers may differ.
how: 24 sleep-lab studies compared nights after caffeine with nights without it, in the same people.
Caffeine made falling asleep slower, waking in the night more common, and sleep lighter.
The more caffeine, and the closer to bedtime, the more sleep people lost.
People often did not notice the extra waking.

cl_caf_withdrawal_headache.q: If I suddenly go without my usual caffeine, will I get a headache?
cl_caf_withdrawal_headache.short: Without their usual caffeine, half got a headache by evening; people given caffeine pills did not.
cl_caf_withdrawal_headache.but: Only 40 hospital patients took part, and surgery itself can also cause headaches.
how: 40 people who drank lots of caffeine had to stop it before a small operation.
Half got caffeine pills and half got dummy pills, and nobody knew which.
By evening, 10 of the 20 with dummy pills had a headache, and none with caffeine.

cl_caf_periop_tablets.q: Can caffeine pills in hospital stop the headache after an operation?
cl_caf_periop_tablets.short: In one small trial, caffeine pills stopped most headaches after surgery, compared with dummy pills.
cl_caf_periop_tablets.but: The trial was small, so it cannot show whether the pills are safe for everyone.
how: The patients were people who usually had a lot of caffeine every day.
Doctors gave either caffeine pills or dummy pills around the operation.
Stomach acid, which caffeine can raise, was the same in both groups.
